Title: Welcome to Cutlass
Description: The ever magnanimous Patricia Reid wishes to welcome you to Spyglass Ridge and Cutlass Keys. Do her a favor, and speak to some of her friends, will ya?
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Something <g id="litearmor_chuckle" priority="high />like that… name’s Pat, and I make it a point to know everyone in town. <g id="litearmor_youknow" />Like to keep my finger on the pulse of the place, you see?
InProgressResponse: Grimm and Oxen, they're both characters, alright.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: That table has treasure aplenty, <g id="litearmor_complimentplayer" />and I've no doubt you'll be coveting the lot. Get out there and bring back a haul of doubloons.

Title: Pirate's Life For Me
Description: First Mate Grimm waits eagerly in the tavern to tell the tale of the cursed doubloons to any and all newcomers. Hear his words and listen well.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Well, not so much a tale as a nightmare. Those doubloons that everyone's after... nobody knows the power they hold. The madness they inflict…
InProgressResponse: Sit down already, we’re in a damned tavern! Rest your legs and feel the fire. You don’t always need to be in such a rush… This won’t take long.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Now, listen and listen well. Those doubloons are mine by right, and I aim to destroy the lot! I brought the curse here, and I aim to rectify that.

Title: It Crawls Beneath Us
Description: James Oxen is seeking a cure for the curse that turned his crew to stone. Speak to Glendyn Trahern in southeastern Cutlass Keys for answers.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: We found Medusa, <g id="litearmor_hopeless" />but she was not alone! Her ravenous brood ripped my crew to pieces. The lucky ones were turned to stone. I- I jumped ship and swam to shore…
InProgressResponse: The carnage... <g id="litearmor_worry" />there's not enough ale in this tavern to wash away what these eyes have seen…
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Greetings, old friend. You must have spoken with Oxen, if you came looking for me here. I'm afraid the captain's story is true... Medusa has returned.

Title: Flesh From Stone (Expedition)
Description: The Broodmother Medusa has turned Oxen's crew to stone and is spawning hordes of Hercyne to claim Aeternum. Gather ingredients for the antidote and defeat her.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Just the attitude Nature needs from the Hero of Aeternum! There's an antidote I can brew. The ingredients can be found in the Hive beyond.
InProgressResponse: Make haste! The longer we dally, the more of her brood will spill forth to contaminate this land!
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: You have my thanks, hero. I only pray that I have the knowledge and intellect necessary to decipher the mysteries of our forebearers.

Title: Smell the Future
Description: Arnold Trost has discovered Lost are repulsed by man-sized sticks of burning incense. Venture into The Salty Marshes and light a Lost Deterrence Pylon to keep them out of Spyglass Ridge.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: It's pure incense, according to Fei, if you can imagine that. I don't think anyone expected those waterlogged corpses to be mindful of strong smells.
InProgressResponse: Every minute you delay the Lost get more organized.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Oh my... I don't know what's worse. The Lost or the smell of that incense... I guess it beats being overrun and beaten to death by a horde of withered ghouls…

Title: Keys to Freedom
Description: Spymaster Bronn wants you to cause a distraction in Pirate's Stand by unleashing the encaged Ancient Guardians upon their jailers. With the enemy occupied, find the prison key and release the pirate captives to bolster our ranks.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: They turn their captives into new crew members. I’ll spare you the grim details of that process. If we save 'em, they'll be in our debt. That's what matters.
InProgressResponse: Be careful, I don’t want to see you in one of those cages. We’re running thin as it is.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: A rough lot you saved. We’ll have to vet them before offering our supplies and arms, but I have a feelin' they'll prove their worth. Good work.

Title: A Shocking Revelation
Description: Help Billiam Rowen with the discovery of his lifetime by defeating the Spectral Tyrant and ridding his cave of Lost! Return to Billiam in Cutlass Keys when you've finished.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Ah, yes! I’ve been charting the skies above Aeternum for years now and stumbled across quite the revelation. Perhaps you’d like to sit down before I tell you.
InProgressResponse: Oh, how I long for the sea at times… But the skies are a rather compelling alternative. I do hope you’re faring well with my request friend!
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: I can’t thank you enough. As long as those Lost stay away, I can confirm my research and seal our names in the history books of this great island!

Title: Whispers of Wealth
Description: A collector named Edwin Kasper is haunted by a voice that demands the recovery of artifacts lost among the shipwrecks of Cutlass Keys. Search for a golden beam to the south west and return the artifacts to satisfy the mysterious voice and save Kasper's sanity.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Please, help me. I hear a voice… it hungers for artifacts that it once possessed.
InProgressResponse: I wish I never found this cursed relic. It's sheer torture what it's putting me through.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: You found them! Surely, surely this is enough to appease it. I hope… at least. Thank you, friend.

Title: Soul Trap
Description: Rosina Bryce's search for supernatural rumors have led her to The Bloody Spike. Defeat warriors living and dead to collect enough Soul Gems for an offering, and see fortune bestowed by The Bloody Spike.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Legend has it living and Lost are both naturally drawn to this spire, and the bloodshed surrounding it hardens the soul into gemstones at the moment of death.
InProgressResponse: You won't find any gemstones standing around, I'd get moving if I were you.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: So the legends are true? The Bloody Spike was feeding off your actions, wasn't it? And you return with the gemstones to boot… well done.

Title: For Guts and Glory
Description: Get your hands dirty and defeat other fighters at the Citadel. Return to Decima Opimius when you have a story worth telling.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Sure have. I can crack a few skulls, sure, but fighting’s not really for me. A spatula’s a bit more my speed. If you’re heading to the Citadel, best prepare!
InProgressResponse: Oh, come now, your stories aren’t nearly good enough to earn your reward yet. Get back to the Citadel and stand your ground!
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: That… Well, goodness! That might actually keep me up at night. I wouldn't have thought you could be so vicious. Hope I never disappoint you with my meals!

Title: Smell the Future
Description: Arnold Trost has discovered Lost are repulsed by man-sized sticks of burning incense. Venture into The Salty Marshes and light a Lost Deterrence Pylon to keep them out of Spyglass Ridge.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: It surely does. We should light more! Keeping pressure on the Lost will ensure they stay busy knocking down incense instead of our doors.
InProgressResponse: I know it's it's dirty work, but it must be done. Get out to the swamp and place more pylons as soon as you can.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Another batch planted? Good. We're all a little safer.
ObjectiveOnCooldownResponse: All this excitement has gotten the Lost a little too riled up for my taste. Thankfully, I've got this here "Lost Deterrence" concoction to ward them off!

Title: Keys to Freedom
Description: Spymaster Bronn wants you to cause a distraction in Pirate's Stand by unleashing the encaged Ancient Guardians upon their jailers. With the enemy occupied, find the prison key and release the pirate captives to bolster our ranks.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Those Sable Fleet bastards are on high alert since your raid. They also managed to capture even more prisoners. We'll need to break them out.
InProgressResponse: I hope you get to the captives before the Sable Fleet enact their judgement. We don’t need even more soulless pirates wandering Cutlass Keys.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: These scallywags look even worse than the last bunch, but they'll increase our strength in numbers, and we should be on the lookout for more in the future.
ObjectiveOnCooldownResponse: Don’t stray too far. With tales of treasure afoot down south, I highly doubt the prison cells will be empty for long.

Title: A Shocking Revelation
Description: Help Billiam Rowen with the discovery of his lifetime by defeating the Spectral Tyrant and ridding his cave of Lost! Return to Billiam in Cutlass Keys when you've finished.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Maybe we'll get lucky and that fiend won't be there… maybe. I can't tell how important this is for me to continue my studies.
InProgressResponse: The night sky is like a vast sea, with constellations as its beautiful creatures. I wonder if I’ll ever come across a manatee star pattern…?
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: I can’t thank you enough. As long as those Lost stay away, I can confirm my research and seal our names in the history books of this great island!
ObjectiveOnCooldownResponse: That spirit you brought down must’ve lived up to the tales. Its power is immense in even small doses, though I fear I’m getting carried away with my usage.

Title: Whispers of Wealth
Description: A collector named Edwin Kasper is haunted by a voice that demands the recovery of artifacts lost among the shipwrecks of Cutlass Keys. Search for a golden beam to the south west and return the artifacts to satisfy the mysterious voice and save Kasper's sanity.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: You’ve been a boon in this wretched situation. Find the golden beam to the south as before. That should lead you to the artifacts.
InProgressResponse: I pray this is the last of it. I can’t take much more…
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: These must be the last pieces. It has to be. Thank you for not running off with such valuables. Your honor in a land of thieves is to be commended.
ObjectiveOnCooldownResponse: It’s time to find out if the intruder in my mind is satisfied with the artifacts you recovered. I should hear a verdict shortly.

Title: Soul Trap
Description: Rosina Bryce's search for supernatural rumors have led her to The Bloody Spike. Defeat warriors living and dead to collect enough Soul Gems for an offering, and see fortune bestowed by The Bloody Spike.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: What do you say we extend our previous deal? Bring us more gems and I'll ensure you find even more fortune.
InProgressResponse: I wouldn't keep The Spike waiting.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: The Bloody Spike and I are pleased, we hope to see you again soon.
ObjectiveOnCooldownResponse: Here because you want to pay The Bloody Spike another visit?

Title: For Guts and Glory
Description: Get your hands dirty and defeat other fighters at the Citadel. Return to Decima Opimius when you have a story worth telling.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: That's the spirit! Get back down to the Citadel and get your hands dirty. I'll get mine dirty too, just with flour... not blood.
InProgressResponse: A dash of cinnamon and perhaps some smoked paprika… Are you allergic to anything? Just trying to make you something special for when you get back.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Are you determined to keep me up at night?! That was disgusting. Well, I suppose I did ask for it, and I hate to admit you've left me wanting even more!
ObjectiveOnCooldownResponse: Good to see you again! You know, your story really only whets my appetite. It inspires my cooking, no doubt, but I must admit I long for another tale soon.

Title: Out of the Frying Pan
Description: Return the set of pots and pans to Cook Swampy in the Cutlass Keys Settlement.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Normally I'd recommend the Cutlass Quiche. But can you believe it, there are some around here who don't appreciate my cooking! My cooking!
InProgressResponse: Have you recovered me pots and pans yet? I once used that frying pan to hit a patron who didn’t pay up. He doesn’t remember it, probably from the concussion.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Ah, let's see… that's them! No better pans in all Aeternum! Oh, I can kiss ya.

Title: In Search of Plunder
Description: Explore Ancient ruins to collect artifacts. Search chests to collect Heron's notes. Talk to Quartermaster Duffy in the Cutlass Keys Settlement when your task is complete.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Word is the Ancient ruins might have some good ol' fashioned plunder in them. A man by the name of Heron came through town a while back, saying as much.
InProgressResponse: All that plunder isn't going to go fall into our laps without some effort! Explore the ruins and bring back what artifacts you find.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Now, that's a sight to behold! Look at all of this beautiful plunder. This is exactly the type of booty a pirate town needs!

Title: Relics of the Tower
Description: Loot relics from chests inside Crow's Nest Lighthouse. Talk to Quartermaster Duffy in the Cutlass Keys Settlement when your task is complete.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Well for starters, you can find some more of those artifacts. I bartered the last batch for more than its weight in gold!
InProgressResponse: It's not as fun as plundering another ship at sea, but raiding ruins is still quite lucrative. And you don't get seasick, neither!
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Magnificent! What unusual artifacts. I'm sure we will have no trouble finding a buyer. I dare say a return to the spire for more may be in order!

Title: Explosive Prospecting
Description: Investigate the source of the tremors in the Highpass Mining Camp and defuse the situation. Talk to Captain Lucian in Spyglass Ridge when the task is complete.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: There's an old mining camp in Pirate's Pass. A band of Lost pirates recently laid claim to it and I fear they may be up to something sinister.
InProgressResponse: What we don't need is a landslide ruining our fine settlement. Investigate the mining camp and put a stop to their plans.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: We'll all sleep safer at night without those explosions rattling the cupboards, but I fear the pirates may soon return.

Title: Lightning in a Bottle
Description: Find elemental materials from spirits and bring them back to Artificer Fei in the Cutlass Keys Settlement.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: You have no doubt seen the numerous specters and phantasms that wander among the Lost. Some of these spirits even display strange elemental properties.
InProgressResponse: We have to find a better way to fight back against the Lost. Perhaps the bottled lightning is the edge we need.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Ah, yes. These will do nicely! Give me some time to prepare the device, and when you return we will begin the next phase of our work!

Title: Lightning Unleashed
Description: Place the Lightning Jars in locations around Fort Barnacles. Talk to Artificer Fei in the Cutlass Keys Settlement when the task is complete.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: I'm glad you asked! Thanks to your combat prowess and my ingenuity, we have literally captured lightning in a bottle. The Lost are about to get quite a shock!
InProgressResponse: Those jars aren't going to test themselves. They need to be around a high concentration of Lost.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Well? Did the lightning traps perform according to expectations? I do hope it was an electrifying experience!

Title: Animal Instincts
Description: Gather samples from wildcats and alligators and bring them to Tosch in Cutlass Keys so he can study how to tame them.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: I'm an animal empath. I can intuit their thoughts and feelings. But sometimes I need more... sometimes I need parts of the animals to understand them.
InProgressResponse: Nature is beautiful, and can be distracting, but you need to stay focused. Remember the goal - seek out wildcats and alligators!
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: These are perfect. Can you imagine having a tame wildcat helping you hunt? Or an alligator keeping the Lost away from your home?

Title: Snaggletooth
Description: Collect a tooth from a fierce lion and bring it to Tosch in Cutlass Keys.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: A lion named Snaggletooth. Seek out his den and return with his legendary fangs. Soon we will be one step closer to taming these magnificent beasts.
InProgressResponse: To catch a lion you need to emulate it - be courageous and boldly go forth to seek it out!
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: This is a very large fang, even among adult lions. I will take some time to study it closely. In the meantime, I have news regarding your previous task.

Title: Catnipping
Description: Gather whiskers from island pumas and bring them to Tosch in Cutlass Keys.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: I've had trouble communicating with the native pumas. If you bring me some of their whiskers, I might be able to attune myself to their thoughts and feelings.
InProgressResponse: Now is no time to behave like a cat! You need to get out there and collect some whiskers from the island pumas!
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: These whiskers should do nicely. I can already feel myself connecting with the spirits of the pumas. I feel we're making progress, but something is yet missing.

Title: Taming the Lionhearted
Description: Gather collars and leashes from tamed dogs and bring them to Tosch in Cutlass Keys.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Lost Pirates! Have you seen the guard dogs they keep at Fort Barnacles? I must have you investigate and report back. There's so much we can learn from them!
InProgressResponse: I'd stay away from the Lost too - but those at Fort Barnacles have the knowledge I seek! I must have those collars and leashes!
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Hmm... I do sense powerful magic within these restraints. Something dark... almost... sinister.

Title: Perfect Companion
Description: Gather boar bristles and bring them to Tosch in Cutlass Keys so he may tame the ultimate pet!
ObjectiveProposalResponse: I shall cut to the chase then. It's a boar! I simply must tame a wild boar. I just need you to slay a few of them first and bring me their bristles.
InProgressResponse: Please find some boar bristles so I can be sure I want one as a pet.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Just feeling these delicate bristles between my fingers brings me a sense of profound joy. I am confident that a boar is the right choice.

Title: A Disturbing Silence
Description: Search for Jocelyn at Castaway's Colony. Talk to Swamp Walker Nekumanesh in Cutlass Keys when the task is complete.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: We had an argument. She wasn't happy with my being away so often for work. Said she was going to find somewhere else to live... that was some time ago.
InProgressResponse: Chatting with you is filling the silence, but I long to hear my wife's voice again. Seek Jocelyn out at Castaway Colony.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: There were no signs of Jocelyn? I was certain she'd be there... multiple people from town saw her heading up there.

Title: Tracking by Teeth
Description: Track Jocelyn by finding her teeth in River's Crossing. Talk to Swamp Walker Nekumanesh in Cutlass Keys when the task is complete.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: They're from River's Crossing. You'll find it just to the west. I'm certain that she must be over there right now, just chatting away with her kinfolk.
InProgressResponse: If only I hadn't gone to help map the swamps in Reekwater. Have you found my wife, or her teeth? River's Crossing is a good place to start looking.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: So, this is all you could find? No signs of Jocelyn? These teeth are unmistakable, definitely hers... where did you find them? All in one place?

Title: Heart of the Marsh
Description: Find Jocelyn and recover a keepsake from her. Talk to Swamp Walker Nekumanesh in Cutlass Keys when the task is complete.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: I do recall someone telling me that they found Jocelyn's trunk and many of her belongings in the marsh near the fishery. She must be there after all!
InProgressResponse: Go on, she doesn't bite, at least, not anymore without her teeth. You'll find Jocelyn at River's Crossing.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: What's this? Jocelyn's diary? It looks thick enough to be a memoir! Did she give you the diary to bring back to me?

Title: Treasure Island
Description: Follow the treasure map Claire provided to discover great riches! Talk to Claire Fergus in Cutlass Keys when the task is done.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Yes! But that’s where my problems begin; it’s only half a map, unfortunately. It points directly to the Cursed Steps, but I can’t seem to find anything there!
InProgressResponse: This is all a bit exciting, isn’t it? I just wish my last partner hadn’t stolen the other half of the map. At least this half has the ‘x’ that marks the spot!
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: That’s it, just a handful of doubloons?! Where's the rest of the treasure? Where are the gems, the piles of gold, the chests of riches I was promised?

Title: Admiral Blackpowder's Fall (Expedition)
Description: Enter the Barnacles and Black Powder Expedition. Gather the chronicles of the infamous Admiral Blackpowder, and take him down for Wally Widdershins.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Hah! Caught your ear, though, didn't I? Same as the Admiral, feeding us golden lies about mysterious treasure on a magic island.
InProgressResponse: Blackpowder... cruelest man in all the seas, and crueler still with that idol. Soon as you've stamped him into the ground, I'm walking the straight and narrow.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Hah! I heard them cannons roaring! You gave ole Blackpowder a taste of his own medicine, eh? No less than the bastard deserved.

Title: Mysteries of the Deep (Expedition)
Description: Enter the Barnacles and Black Powder Expedition to disrupt the work of a suspected Water Elemental for Rowan Pennbrook.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Can you imagine? A whole region of Aeternum under water. Of course I can't prove it, but... I did track a Water Elemental to this very lair. Hopefully those pirate fools haven't reached the Elemental's sanctum, though I suspect it is very deep within the caverns.
InProgressResponse: In my heyday, I hunted all kinds of Elementals across Aeternum. Ha, just talking about it gets my blood pumping!
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: You say she was called a 'Nereid?' Fascinating, fascinating! Even if this Nereid said nothing about an underwater city, she must have come from somewhere, and come here for some purpose. Now to find out what it was…

Title: Cleansing Treasure (Expedition)
Description: Enter the Barnacles and Black Powder Expedition to collect golden trinkets from the crewmembers. Bring them back to Quiggley Quorus to cleanse and sell them.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Aye. I was a holy man once upon a time, but no more, no more. Poverty and celibacy? What a terrible bore!
InProgressResponse: I've nothing but holy water and wits! You'll fight and bring me the baubles and bits!
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: I've a buyer in mind, but first I must pay you in kind. Take your reward, take your coin, and hurry back for more to purloin!

Title: Cleansing Treasure (Expedition)
Description: Enter the Barnacles and Black Powder Expedition to collect golden trinkets from the crewmembers. Bring them back to Quiggley Quorus to cleanse and sell them.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Aye. I was a holy man once upon a time, but no more, no more. Poverty and celibacy? What a terrible bore!
InProgressResponse: I've nothing but holy water and wits! You'll fight and bring me the baubles and bits!
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: I've a buyer in mind, but first I must pay you in kind. Take your reward, take your coin, and hurry back for more to purloin!
ObjectiveOnCooldownResponse: Useful, useful, yes you were. And so bold! Many a bauble have I, ready to be sold. Come back soon young scallywag, and I'll have more loot for you to bag.

Title: Out of the Frying Pan
Description: Return the set of pots and pans to Cook Swampy in the Cutlass Keys Settlement.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: It’s probably the same delinquents from Spire Rock Fort. I admire their taste in cookware, but those are family heirlooms.
InProgressResponse: Any luck finding my pots and pans? I can’t believe they found my secret compartment under the rug. Uh oh…
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: You brought my pans! Thanks again. I'll cook you up an old Swampy special... on the house of course!
ObjectiveOnCooldownResponse: No chance anyone’s stealing my precious pots and pans ever again. I made sure to lock’em up tight this time. But if they get lucky, I know who to send their way.

Title: Relics of the Tower
Description: Loot relics from chests inside Crow's Nest Lighthouse. Talk to Quartermaster Duffy in the Cutlass Keys Settlement when your task is complete.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: But of course! There's always loot to be found if one looks in the right place, and Malocchio Spire is surely the right place!
InProgressResponse: Ahoy! Do you have the booty?
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Your plundering has brought welcome disrepute to our fine, pirate town! Well done!
ObjectiveOnCooldownResponse: Best let those pirates cool down for a bit. Wouldn't want them to migrate their smuggling grounds.

Title: Explosive Prospecting
Description: Investigate the source of the tremors in the Highpass Mining Camp and defuse the situation. Talk to Captain Lucian in Spyglass Ridge when the task is complete.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: If you would be so kind. We would prefer to keep the mountain, and our town for that matter, intact.
InProgressResponse: Show those Lost brigands that we will not stand idly by while they threaten our town.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: That should deter those greedy bastards for some time. Thanks.
ObjectiveOnCooldownResponse: The hills sound quiet for now… I'll flag you down if and when they starting acting up again.

Title: Lightning in a Bottle
Description: Find elemental materials from spirits and bring them back to Artificer Fei in the Cutlass Keys Settlement.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: The work order is requesting the necessary resources for more bottled lightning. Bring the resources, take a doubloon. Honor system of course.
InProgressResponse: The box sits, silent, waiting for goods.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: No doubt Fei Lixin is grateful, and you're now a bit richer.
ObjectiveOnCooldownResponse: The box appears full. Come back later.

Title: Lightning Unleashed
Description: Place the Lightning Jars in locations around Fort Barnacles. Talk to Artificer Fei in the Cutlass Keys Settlement when the task is complete.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Several, actually. Mostly minor tweaks, but enough to warrant further testing. Head back to Fort Barnacles and deploy them in the same way as before!
InProgressResponse: Those jars aren't going to test themselves. They need to be around a high concentration of Lost.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Ah, excellent work as always! But innovation requires iteration, as they say, so please return soon for the next round of testing.
ObjectiveOnCooldownResponse: My work has never progressed this steadily. The data you collected has been invaluable, friend. All these new developments may just warrant another test soon!

Title: Animal Instincts
Description: Gather samples from wildcats and alligators and bring them to Tosch in Cutlass Keys so he can study how to tame them.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: I’m so glad you found one of my collecting stations! Since you’re here, why not help me out a trifle? I am in need of both wildcat claws and alligator scales.
InProgressResponse: Nature is beautiful, and can be distracting, but you need to stay focused. This collecting station won't fill itself!
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Tosch is sure to find these samples useful, just as he's sure to not miss this doubloon he so graciously left lying here.
ObjectiveOnCooldownResponse: The box appears full. Come back later.

Title: Snaggletooth
Description: Collect a tooth from a fierce lion and bring it to Tosch in Cutlass Keys.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Excellent work, locating another of my collecting stations! I could do with more Snaggleteeth, drop one off here and take some coin for your trouble.
InProgressResponse: It would be much simpler to take the reward left here by Tosch, but something resembling a conscience is keeping you from this act of blatant thievery.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: You drop a tooth into the box and hear it clatter against numerous other teeth. It sounds distressingly similar to the coin you drop in your purse.
ObjectiveOnCooldownResponse: This station is filled with animal parts, it would be best to wait for Tosch to gather them and refill the stash of coins.

Title: Catnipping
Description: Gather whiskers from island pumas and bring them to Tosch in Cutlass Keys.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Good on you, finding my collecting station! Had to hide it so bandits stopped stealing from it. I could use more island puma whiskers, for a reward of course.
InProgressResponse: This station is still empty and sad, bring back some puma whiskers to make it filled and glad!
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: "How many whiskers can one man need?" The question plagues your mind as you set them in the designated basket.
ObjectiveOnCooldownResponse: The box appears full. Come back later.

Title: Taming the Lionhearted
Description: Gather collars and leashes from tamed dogs and bring them to Tosch in Cutlass Keys.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: This is bittersweet, you've found the last of my collecting stations! Gather more of those evil harnesses and bring them here so I may destroy them.
InProgressResponse: Standing before Tosch's final collecting station makes your heart hurt. You steel yourself before the work ahead.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: You stuff the leather straps into the box with some effort. All that work deserves a reward, and Tosch has graciously provided.
ObjectiveOnCooldownResponse: This station is filled with collars and leashes, it would be best to wait for Tosch to gather them and refill the stash of coins.

Title: Perfect Companion
Description: Gather boar bristles and bring them to Tosch in Cutlass Keys so he may tame the ultimate pet!
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Ah, I was so lost in thought I didn't see you there! I’ve been using boar’s hair wherever I can, embracing the essence of boar. Could you get more for me?
InProgressResponse: You don't want to hear another boar pun do you? I promise it won't be pretty! Get going before I think up another ab-boar-rent joke!
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: My joy in receiving these boar bristles has yet to diminish, nor has my gratitude to you for delivering them to me!
ObjectiveOnCooldownResponse: Lining clothes, stuffing pillows, knitting blankets, I'm keeping very busy. I'll let you know when I need more boar bristles!

Title: Treasure Island
Description: Follow the treasure map Claire provided to discover great riches! Talk to Claire Fergus in Cutlass Keys when the task is done.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: There must be! I refuse to believe that traitor I once called a partner was able to best me in my treasure hunt. Get back out there and find whatever you can!
InProgressResponse: Look, I'm flattered, but what are you doing coming back here and talkin' my ear off? It's not a courtship I'm looking for, it's treasure!
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: By the Kracken, is that really all that was left? This really is looking dire… Maybe if we wait a bit longer, something will turn up?
ObjectiveOnCooldownResponse: Unbelievable… Simply unbelievable. That just can’t be all that was left. We may need to search those ruins again soon; I refuse to give up that easily.
